source.source_locator: 教則 第4章 4.4「機体の動力源」(2)2)リチウムポリマーバッテリーの取り扱い上の注意点

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: LiPoの過放電・過充電は急速な劣化と寿命短縮につながる。
evidence.tested_misconception: 過放電/過充電はbattery healthに影響しない。
evidence.reasoning_path: charge abuse -> accelerated degradation -> shorter life

collision.note: MEDIUM-LOW。Q033は膨張したbatteryの交換判断、Q072は短絡発火であり、overcharge/dischargeによる寿命劣化が中心。

independent_review.rationale: 4.4 states overcharge/overdischarge accelerates LiPo degradation and shortens life; distinct from Q033 swelling replacement and Q072 short-circuit fire.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review is source-consistent, preserves second-class scope, and correctly rejects two sensor-fact candidates whose answer-defining propositions are already represented in released questions. The remaining 28 candidates cover distinct Chapter 4 system characteristics, equipment boundaries, sensor principles, powertrain/battery behavior, and radio propagation with useful commercial practice value.
